about:
Fabric Depot & Supply has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 1991. The business is family-owned and opened its doors as a fabric resource for both consumers and local trade customers.

The company runs a large showroom stocking more than 750 fabrics and over 700 rolls, alongside 10-plus foam densities, batting, webbing, trim, and commercial adhesives. In-house upholstery and seamstress teams handle custom cushion fabrication, drapery, bedding, outdoor shade covers, and reupholstery for residential, automotive, and marine applications. The location also carries flooring lines including hardwood, laminate, carpet, and luxury vinyl, and serves as an authorized dealer for brands such as Sunbrella, Revolution, Outdura, and California Umbrella.

Customers range from homeowners and interior designers to automotive and marine upholstery shops, hospitality venues, and commercial contractors. The shop supplies auto carpet, headliners, and marine vinyl to transportation specialists, while its custom drapery and hardware programs serve residential and commercial window treatments. Local businesses also source foam, trim, and hardware for furniture production and refurbishment.

The operation distinguishes itself by combining a broad retail inventory with full-service fabrication under one roof, allowing clients to select materials and have them cut, sewn, and finished on site. The company emphasizes its ability to special-order virtually any fabric, foam shape, or drapery hardware configuration to meet project-specific requirements.
